construction_interfaces.reason: 319: bind semantic front/up, head-versus-torso ownership and visible prop/cuff frames before adaptation. Freeze coordinates/normals before surface mutation; prove one complete actor/pose before variants. Test the fastest dependent motion at every rendered frame where needed: four-frame sleeve sampling missed a109.5mm spear-plant cuff gap. Preserve working whole forms during local fixes; pointwise hair projection can jump between surfaces. Keep actual per-version recipes, reconcile file-level rights, and measure identical-frame render profiles. Numeric contact, source hashes and strand counts do not establish visible grip, same-film coherence or full-speed AV acceptance. 320: select the intended garment exterior, not an ambiguous nearest side. Calibrate limb lengths to rest anatomy, solve both feet against one pelvis, and respect nonuniform transforms. Inspect clothed partial poses before propagation. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.

reuse_envelope.reason: 317: evaluate reuse before custom construction without forcing it; compare total adaptation/revalidation cost and quality. Extend existing provenance with source/version/rights/dependencies, tested conditions, failures/evidence and measured-or-unknown effort. Run resource_manifest for the requested use; missing/stale evidence, untested conditions, unresolved rights or open failures block qualification. Assessed resources stay useful but unqualified. Manually verify applicability, rights and perceptual truth; a valid record is not an artistic pass. No new database, installation, spend or upload. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.

vehicle_response.reason: D316-01: separate chassis response from wheel/terrain contact; preserve rough road, rolling/slip and brake intent. Check fork/axle, lamp, hand/grip, boot/peg and planted-foot interfaces, not just reduced chassis jerk.317 filter is shot-authored, not general dynamics. Changed speed, road, wheelbase or framing requires revalidation. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.

animal_coordination.reason: D316-02-04: compare elapsed reference phases, joint/hoof axes, support/weight transfer, brief active apex, head/neck and rider/spear/reins through landing. More keyed joints are not naturalness. Distinguish coat from clay/metal under matched lighting; preserve eyes/muzzle/hooves and bind short nap to actual deformation. Keep direct motion judgment pending under313; source/timed frames do not certify continuous performance. Trace constraints through the actual visible hoof endpoint and test grounded/airborne ownership transfer; keyed evaluated quaternion controls, not temporary property edits, are valid diagnostics. 320: trace the complete saddle/pelvis/thigh/knee/ankle/stirrup chain; animated torso/root can conceal static legs. Keep descent momentum into contact before absorption, and judge actual full-speed fluidity separately. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.

crowd_support.reason: D316-06: purposeful anticipation, weight transfer, staggered non-crossing steps and world-planted support, with torso/gaze and connected costume/props. Rebuild visible clothing when joints change. Verify near/far actors and corridor clearance. Random sway or upright root translation is not life; donor motion requires actual skeleton/contact compatibility. Keep bake sources evaluated but render-hidden; bind full timeline explicitly and measure actual evaluated garment-to-boot/hand interfaces. Reachable targets can still create split-like strides; inspect clothed support and natural step width separately. 320: this crowd keeps watching the rider while making room. Couple gaze, torso opening, supported feet and final stance; a head-only correction can exceed neck range. Test all actors and visible attention, not just staggered timing or target angles. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.

drainage_use.reason: D316-05: cluster rooted growth, broken stubble, erosion and deposits by drainage/use; preserve lane and occupied crossings. Avoid uniform scatter or continuous green strips. Ground-support changes invalidate wheel, foot and FX checks. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.

visual_gate.reason: Compare the complete claimed result to accepted references and required use, seeking known and new failures plus adjacent regressions. anticipation.reason: Write audience intent and distraction hypotheses before a defect list. Test them against actual evidence, seek counterevidence and unlisted problems, record observations and corrections. Director feedback calibrates fallible judgment; it is not the primary defect detector.224: test opening hook, pacing and causal geography, not merely fit duration.248 adopts larger-than-life impact for The Martials and records it as a Director preference: name the extraordinary character-specific beat and its preparation/payoff; use contrast and believability, not constant maximum speed/loudness or unapproved powers. 249 requires a shot/beat performance and believability brief before execution: apply relevant expertise lenses, predict audience-visible anatomy/contact/physical-response failures, and bind each critical behavior to strategy, interfaces, early proof and observable failure conditions. Cover each beat or explicit inheritance; consult docs/planning/SHOT_BEAT_QUALITY_BRIEF.md. Roles are perspectives, not an org chart. Automatic brief completeness and perceptual judgment are not implemented. Scope: do not reconstruct excluded scenery/vehicle; report relevant unperformed checks as NOT_RUN.
